import Ramsey

open Ramsey Ramsey.Boundary

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

example {B X Y : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    (G : SimpleGraph (B ⊕ X)) (H : SimpleGraph (B ⊕ Y))
    (h : profile G 3 3 = profile H 3 3) :
    IsRamseyGraph 3 3
        (relabel (forget (introduce (glue (glue G G true) G false) Set.univ true) none)
          (Equiv.refl _)) ↔
      IsRamseyGraph 3 3
        (relabel (forget (introduce (glue (glue H G true) G false) Set.univ true) none)
          (Equiv.refl _)) := by
  let leaf : UniformDerivation (ProfileRelation 3 3) G H := .leaf h
  let joined := leaf.glue_of_profiles (.fixed G) true rfl
  let antiJoined := joined.glue_of_profiles (.fixed G) false rfl
  exact uniform_replacement_isRamseyGraph
    (((antiJoined.introduce Set.univ true).forget none).relabel (Equiv.refl _))

example {B X Y : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    (G : SimpleGraph (B ⊕ X)) (H : SimpleGraph (B ⊕ Y))
    (h : profile G 1 1 = profile H 1 1)
    (hn : Fintype.card (B ⊕ X) = Fintype.card (B ⊕ Y)) :
    profile (forget (introduce G Set.univ false) none) 1 1 =
        profile (forget (introduce H Set.univ false) none) 1 1 ∧
      Fintype.card ({b : Option B // b ≠ none} ⊕ Option X) =
        Fintype.card ({b : Option B // b ≠ none} ⊕ Option Y) := by
  let leaf : UniformDerivation (OrderedProfileRelation 1 1) G H := .leaf ⟨h, hn⟩
  exact uniform_ordered_replacement ((leaf.introduce Set.univ false).forget none)

example : Finite (Profile (Fin 0) 1 1) := inferInstance

example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 0 ⊕ Fin 0)) : IsRamseyGraph 1 1 G := by
  rw [isRamseyGraph_iff_homogeneousNumber_lt]
  exact ⟨(homogeneousNumber_lt_one_iff G true).2 inferInstance,
    (homogeneousNumber_lt_one_iff G false).2 inferInstance⟩

example {X : Type} [Fintype X] (G : SimpleGraph (Bool ⊕ X)) (p q : ℕ) :
    let b₁ : {a : Bool // a ≠ false} := ⟨true, by decide⟩
    let b₀ : {a : Bool // a ≠ true} := ⟨false, by decide⟩
    ∃ e : {a : {b : Bool // b ≠ false} // a ≠ b₁} ≃
        {a : {b : Bool // b ≠ true} // a ≠ b₀},
      profile (relabel (forget (forget G false) b₁) e) p q =
        profile (forget (forget G true) b₀) p q := by
  dsimp only
  let b₁ : {a : Bool // a ≠ false} := ⟨true, by decide⟩
  let b₀ : {a : Bool // a ≠ true} := ⟨false, by decide⟩
  let D₁ := {a : {b : Bool // b ≠ false} // a ≠ b₁}
  let D₀ := {a : {b : Bool // b ≠ true} // a ≠ b₀}
  haveI : IsEmpty D₁ := ⟨by
    intro a
    have ha : a.val = b₁ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hh := a.val.property
      cases h : a.val.val <;> simp_all [b₁]
    exact a.property ha⟩
  haveI : IsEmpty D₀ := ⟨by
    intro a
    have ha : a.val = b₀ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hh := a.val.property
      cases h : a.val.val <;> simp_all [b₀]
    exact a.property ha⟩
  let e : D₁ ≃ D₀ := Equiv.equivOfIsEmpty _ _
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  let f₁ : (D₀ ⊕ Option (Option X)) ≃ (Bool ⊕ X) :=
    ((Equiv.sumCongr e.symm (Equiv.refl _)).trans (forgetEquiv b₁)).trans
      (forgetEquiv false)
  let f₀ : (D₀ ⊕ Option (Option X)) ≃ (Bool ⊕ X) :=
    (forgetEquiv b₀).trans (forgetEquiv true)
  have h := profile_eq_of_same_retained_boundary (p := p) (q := q) G f₁ f₀
    (fun b ↦ isEmptyElim b)
  exact h

#print axioms uniform_replacement
#print axioms uniform_ordered_replacement
#print axioms uniform_replacement_isRamseyGraph
